infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the EMERCOM medical care unit on Interchange.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: EMERCOM medical unit key (EMC) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the EMERCOM medical care unit at the ULTRA shopping mall.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - Ambulance near the big gas station. You have to jump inside to grab the key off the seat.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text:
Located on the first floor of the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange. On the north side of the center mall.
- This location has 3 different doors that can be unlocked. Opening each door will use a point of durability on the key.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Medbag
- 1x Sports bag
- 1x Jacket
- Loose loot (Meds, Medical supplies, Valuables)
- Portable defibrillator spawn
- LEDX Skin Transilluminator spawn

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text: | Disposable syringe x5; Disposable syringe; +; Iskra ration pack x3; Iskra ration pack; +; Ophthalmoscope x1; Ophthalmoscope | → | Therapist; Therapist LL3 | → | EMERCOM medical unit key; EMERCOM medical unit key |
